selection: Super Lube 93003 O-Ring Silicone Grease, 85 g tube, as an ordinary U30 EPDM cable-channel candidate. Not the identified Onset-supplied grease or an approved product substitution.

sources.locator: Page 8: 93003, 3 oz / 85 g tube; 12 is the shipping pack count, not twelve tubes selected for this laboratory.
Manufacturer SKU image, inspected at native 1024 px. Silver tapered tube, textured heat seal with Euro hanging slot, pale ribbed cap. Original model text replaces copyrighted artwork.
Pages 2–3: EPDM, PC and PBT compatibility E; silicone rubber NC; specific gravity 1.11 at 25 C. Page 4: clean mating surfaces, apply evenly, do not mix greases.
Section 9: relative density 0.96 at 20 C, inconsistent with the TDS. Sections 6–7: absorbent collection, cleaning and closed-container storage.
Page 1: EPDM cable channel and silicone-rubber enclosure gaskets. Pages 9–10: silicone grease for the channel; the door gasket is a distinct part.

reconstruction.dimension_status: Photo-proportion and capacity hypothesis; 54 mm seal width selects the scale, 152 mm height follows the frontal image, and 32 mm depth is inferred from capacity. Not measured package dimensions.
reconstruction.density_status: The two published densities are alternative capacity scenarios, not a measured temperature law. No interpolation or assertion that the discrepancy is caused by temperature.
reconstruction.thread_status: External ridge and internal clearance envelope are inferred. Thread engagement, sealing preload, squeezing and opening are not qualified.
reconstruction.cad_status: No manufacturer CAD retrieved. Original authored geometry and identification text. Source photograph remains external.

usage_limits: Candidate destination: U30 EPDM cable channel only. Exclude the silicone-rubber door gasket and optical surfaces.
Actual sensor cable jacket and plug material compatibility remain unverified; the published EPDM rating does not qualify the complete seal assembly.
One 85 g tube is selected; the two density scenarios and all inspection views are the same inventory identity.
Do not mix with the silicone-free mast grease. Use a separate ordinary applicator and track residues.
The 3 g fresh-assembly allowance is a planning inference: 0.5 g channel, 0.5 g each for four cable paths, and 0.5 g loss. The future external-power cable is reserved but not yet installed.
Three fresh assemblies reserve 9 g and leave 76 g; trial/reset budgets and calibrated dose remain open.
